definitions.short: to melt , i.e. literally (to soften , flow down, disappear ), or figuratively (to fear , faint )
definitions.usage: consume, dissolve, (be) faint(-hearted), melt (away), make soft.
definitions.full: H4127. mug מוּג verb melt ( מוּג ᵑ7 Ithpe`el, Psa 46:7 ; 107:26 ; compare Arabic surge (of the sea), Qor 18:99; a wave ); **in view of prevailing figurative use, and of Arabic () be in tumult, commotion , of sea, people, be agitated, perplexed , it is perhaps dubious whether melt is original meaning; be moved, agitated is usually possibly, and even Amos 9:13 ; Psa 65:11 (both late), where (especially Amos) moistening is suggested, this may be perhaps derived from agitating, loosening, dissolving . — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular תָּמוּג 46:7; וַתָּמוֺג Amos 9:5 ; 2 masculine singular suffix וַתְּמוּגֵ֫נוּ Isa 64:6 (but read probably וַתְּמַגְּנֵנוּ , see [ מָגַן ] p.171 above, and compare Di > Du תְּמַגְּנֵנוּ ); Infinitive לָמוּג Ezek 21:20 ; — 1 melt , subject אֶרֶץ , at touch of ׳י Amos 9:5 ; at voice of ׳י Psa 46:7 ; = faint (of heart), Ezek 21:20 . 2 transitive cause to melt Isa 64:6 (but see above) Niph`al Perfect נָמוֺג Nahum 2:7 2 t.; 3 plural נָמֹ֫גוּ Exod 15:15 3 t.; Participle plural נְמֹגִים Psa 75:4 ; — melt away , figurative for be helpless, disorganized (through terror, etc.) Exod 15:15 (compare context), Josh 2:9 , 24 ; 1Sam 14:16 (compare We Dr), Jer 49:23 , compare Nahum 2:7 ; Isa 14:31 ; Psa 75:4 . Po>l. soften, dissolve , active: only Imperfect 2 masculine singular suffix (subject God): תְּמֹגְגֶנָּה בִּרְבִיבִם Psa 65:11 thou softenest it [the earth] with showers ; figurative, = dissipate וּתְמֹגְגֵ֫נִי Job 30:22 — We reads וַיְמֹגֵג Hab 3:6 for וַיְמֹדֶד , see מדד Po`el Hithpo`el Perfect 3 plural הִתְמֹגָָֽגוּ Nahum 1:5 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּתְמוֺגָ֑ג Psa 107:26 ; 3 feminine plural תִּתְמוֺגַגְנָה Amos 9:13 ; — melt , subject hills (before ׳י ) Nahum 1:5 ; subject נֶפֶשׁ Psa 107:26 (in terror); hyperb. for flow Amos 9:13 (of fertile hills, || הֶהָרִים הִטִּ֫יפוּ ). I. מוד (√ of following; apparently secondary form of מדד , compare Ba NB § 190 c, and Arabic stretch, extend , also prolong, make to continue ).

occurrences.englishText: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed.
She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”
The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.
You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it.
Yahweh of Armies is with us.
You crown the year with your bounty.
I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!”
They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths.
Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
For we have all become like one who is unclean,
You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.
The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
